about: Surfing Woolacombe, which also uses the name Hunter Surf School, is based by the slipway on Woolacombe Beach in north Devon. It runs group courses from a single taster to five sessions, along with private lessons for individuals, families and friends. Changing facilities, showers and lockers are on site.
offers: Group lessons from a 2-hour taster to 5-session courses
Taster plus 4-hour board and suit hire
Private family or friends sessions for up to 8
Under-8s in private or family lessons only
where: Woolacombe Beach at the slipway, Challacombe Hill Rd, Woolacombe EX34 7BA
goodToKnow: New four-season wetsuits; boots, gloves and hoods in winter
Showers, changing and lockers on site
Book group lessons online; request private lessons via the contact page
gaps: No season, accreditation or cancellation terms; the site uses both Surfing Woolacombe and Hunter Surf School branding.
